xna-type.name: ContentImporterAttribute
xna-type.summary: Provides properties that identify and provide metadata about the importer, such as supported file extensions and caching information.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of ContentImporterAttribute and sets the file name extension supported by the importer.

parameters.parameter: The list of file name extensions supported by the importer. Prefix each extension with a '.'.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of ContentImporterAttribute and sets the file name extensions supported by the importer.

parameters.parameter: [ ParamArrayAttribute ] The list of file name extensions supported by the importer. Prefix each extension with a '.'.

property.name: CacheImportedData
property.summary: Gets and sets the caching of the content during importation.

property.name: DefaultProcessor
property.summary: Gets or sets the name of the default processor for content read by this importer.

property.name: DisplayName
property.summary: Gets or sets the string representing the importer in a user interface. This name is not used by the content pipeline and should not be passed to the BuildAssets task. It is used for display purposes only.
property.syntax: public virtual string DisplayName { get; set; }

property.name: FileExtensions
property.summary: Gets the supported file name extensions of the importer.
